chunks: 4419 - Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who wishes to marry a woman who has been divorced three times, how should he proceed concerning her? He said:

He should leave her until she menstruates and becomes pure. Then he should go to her husband with two men, and say to him, 'You have divorced so-and-so?' So if he says, 'Yes,' he should leave her for three months, then propose to her for himself.

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman being considered for marriage
key_terms.رَجُلَانِ: two men as witnesses or accompanying persons

ai.seo_question: How should a man proceed if he wants to marry a woman who has been divorced three times?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about how a man should proceed when intending to marry a woman who has been divorced three times. It outlines a process of verification and waiting, indicating care in matters of divorce, waiting periods, and remarriage.
